ask: Show current session and subscription usage, reset times, and history.
plugin: A statusline and /usage skill collect available session metrics and query authorized usage sources; a monitor stores history and renders threshold alerts.

ask: Track token and money spend by request, session, project, agent and tool.
plugin: Settings hooks record tool and turn events; a statusline and command report cost by scope and export JSON or CSV.

ask: Warn, pause or request approval before a session spends beyond a budget.
plugin: A function hook reads session usage before each model turn and gates new turns at configured thresholds; a settings hook can warn before expensive tool calls.

ask: Choose models and effort by task, project, command, agent or budget.
plugin: Function hooks route turn.step and agent.spawn models; a skill exposes presets and a statusline shows the active choice.

ask: Choose compaction model and control when context is compacted or pruned.
plugin: Function hooks handle session.compact, select a summary model at turn.step, and retain only chosen context; a command offers manual pruning.

ask: Preserve useful files and decisions across compaction and new sessions.
plugin: Session hooks persist a curated memory bundle and reinject it at session start; a skill lets users pin or exclude files.

ask: Estimate prompt, file and tool token footprint before submission.
plugin: A command and UserPromptSubmit hook count local context and warn or trim when the estimate exceeds a budget.

ask: Load only relevant MCP tools and hide unwanted schemas.
plugin: A function hook defers tool.describe and filters offered tools; a command switches MCP profiles.

ask: Find and lazily offer the relevant skills and agents.
plugin: Function hooks filter agent.offer and skill or command listings, backed by a searchable local index.

ask: Search a precomputed codebase index to reduce repeated exploration.
plugin: An MCP server indexes files and exposes semantic search and reference tools; a skill teaches when to query it.

ask: Set conditional permissions by project, tool input and outcome.
plugin: Settings hooks inspect PreToolUse and PermissionRequest inputs and decide allow, ask or deny using named profiles.

ask: Prevent accidental destructive file, shell, cloud or database actions.
plugin: PreToolUse hooks inspect proposed actions against user policy and request confirmation or block high-risk operations.

ask: Summarize or truncate large tool results before they consume context.
plugin: A function hook transforms tool.call results and preserves full output in a sidecar file accessible by command.

ask: Resize, convert and validate images or PDFs before Claude reads them.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook and image/PDF MCP tools transform oversize or mismatched media and report the artifact path.

ask: Detect stalled or looping subagents and stop them within a budget.
plugin: Function hooks measure each agent turn and tool call, enforce time and token caps, and expose a kill command.

ask: Monitor, resume and control local long-running sessions and tasks.
plugin: A monitor tracks process and session state; commands list, resume, cancel and show execution history.

ask: Attach remote clients to a running Claude Code session.
plugin: Function hooks observe session attachment and an MCP channel provides authenticated remote control and live status.

ask: Select a local Claude Code profile or billing credential per project.
plugin: A bin launcher chooses a configured CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or credential source and starts a separate Claude process; statusline shows the selected profile.

ask: Load external secrets into tools without placing them in repository settings.
plugin: A bin credential helper reads OS keychain or 1Password on demand and an MCP server uses it for third-party integrations.

ask: Bridge MCP servers that Claude Code cannot authenticate to directly.
plugin: A local MCP proxy performs OAuth or static-header authentication and exposes a compatible stdio server; credentials stay in secure storage.

ask: Search and import Claude.ai chats and project knowledge when an authorized export or API is available.
plugin: An MCP server indexes user-provided exports or an accessible API; a skill pulls selected context into a code session.

ask: Produce clean terminal output that copies into other tools.
plugin: An output style and MessageDisplay hook suppress formatting artifacts and offer a copy command.

ask: Customize terminal indicators, themes and notifications.
plugin: A theme and statusline display selected metrics; function hooks handle UI details beyond the standard settings API.

ask: Transform prompts, system sections, reminders and final output consistently.
plugin: Function hooks rewrite prompt.submit, prompt.section, prompt.attachment and turn.complete under user rules.

ask: Keep plans, approvals and execution steps aligned.
plugin: A skill defines the plan workflow and hooks verify plan acceptance before edits or external actions.

ask: Recover or preserve a session when a tool or model call fails.
plugin: A StopFailure hook captures error context and a command offers retry, transcript repair or a fresh-session handoff.

ask: Use non-Anthropic or local models for selected tasks.
plugin: An MCP tool calls configured local or third-party providers and a function hook routes eligible turn or agent requests.

ask: Handle small deterministic tasks without full model turns.
plugin: Bin executables and commands provide local calculations, acknowledgements and metadata lookups.

ask: Export session history and structured events for downstream tools.
plugin: A SessionEnd hook serializes transcript events and a command exports selected sessions to JSONL or Markdown.

ask: Emit richer OpenTelemetry data for tools, agents, models and limits.
plugin: Settings hooks and function hooks collect local events and export labeled OTLP metrics.

ask: Let an MCP server request model sampling through the Claude Code session.
plugin: An experimental function hook registers a sampling-capable MCP bridge and routes approved sample requests into the active model context.

ask: Expose MCP connection, disconnect and heartbeat events.
plugin: A monitor observes MCP server processes and a function hook emits connection state to a statusline and log.

ask: Use GitLab repositories, merge requests and related events from Claude Code.
plugin: A GitLab MCP server exposes repository and merge request APIs, with skills for review and creation.

ask: Read and update Jira issues despite native integration gaps.
plugin: A Jira MCP server uses user-configured credentials and exposes issue search, comments and transitions.

ask: Use HealthEx data from Claude Code.
plugin: An MCP server exposes the authorized HealthEx API as namespaced tools.

ask: Perform and attribute GitHub operations through a chosen identity.
plugin: A bin command wraps gh with a selected profile and a skill handles the repository workflow.

ask: Sync selected Claude Code settings and commands across machines.
plugin: A bin command exports, diffs and imports user-approved config files through a configured repository or storage service.

ask: Select among separate identities for the same external service.
plugin: An MCP server maintains named credential profiles and routes calls to the chosen account.

ask: Reduce redundant searches, reads and agent launches that waste tokens.
plugin: A skill gives a bounded search workflow while hooks detect repeated tool calls and warn or block loops.

ask: Keep stable prompt content in the cacheable prefix and surface cache churn.
plugin: Function hooks normalize prompt sections and attachments; a statusline reports cache creation and read rates.

ask: Show Anthropic service incidents in the coding session.
plugin: A monitor reads the public status feed and a statusline displays current incidents.
